news.title: A Missile Alert Half a World Away Interrupts Court Hearing at Guantánamo
news.summary: A possible expert witness was hurried off a video feed after an emergency alert in Dubai, just south of the Strait of Hormuz, a flashpoint in the U.S.-Iran war.
